title: Spatial and temporal variations of ambient PM2.5, NO2, and O3 in Kigali: evidence and policy implications from a multi-year, citywide monitoring network
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00433K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Augustine Omodieke, Daniel Twum, Egide Kalisa
The first multi-year, citywide study in Rwanda found that pollutant levels vary by land-use type and that low-cost sensors can reliably fill air-quality data gap in Africa.
